items.difficulty_reason: In a fibre product diagram of algebraic spaces over a scheme whose morphisms are formally unramified, the lemma shows that the universal first order thickening of the fibre product is the fibre product of the thickenings and remains flat over the target when the relevant thickening is flat. The proof compares the two thickenings through their universal property and then verifies the flatness statement using that flatness is preserved under base change. The comparison plus the base-change argument for flatness is the content. Retained author proof at lines 3295-3340.
